headline: RIOT COPS 👮‍♂️ CLASH 🥊 With Students 📚 As France 🇫🇷 Education 🔥 Protests RAGE 😡
text:
RIOT 🚨 POLICE 👮‍♂️ have CLASHED 🥊 HARD with THOUSANDS 👥 of high 🏫 school students 📖 protesting 🪧 over education 📏 standards 📉 and lack ❌ of teachers 👩‍🏫 as the chaos 🔥 spread across more than 700 🏦 schools 🏫 in France 🇫🇷 on Friday 📅!! Fires 🔥 burned 🔥 in the streets 🛣️ while pupils 👦 objected 😤 to overcrowded 🐄 classrooms 🪑 run down 🏚️ buildings 🧱 and the whole mess 🥴 leaving everyone 🫨 heated 🔥!! The protests 🪧 kicked 🦵 off last week 📆 in Paris 🗼 then raced 🏃‍♂️ across cities 🏙️ like Montpellier 🏞️ Nantes 🛳️ and Marseille 🌊 with students 📚 blocking gates 🚧 and lighting 🔥 bins 🗑️ everywhere 🌍!! Justice ⚖️ Minister Gerald Darmanin 🧔‍♂️ called it a shift 🔄 from innocent school demos 🏫 to full public order disturbance 🚨 saying the vibe 😵 has gotten way too rowdy 🤬!!

A SEVENTEEN 🔢 year old 🧒 was arrested 🔒 in Belfort 🏔️ on suspicion 🕵️ of attempted homicide 🔪 after a police officer 👮‍♂️ got targeted 🎯 during the madness 🌀!! At least sixty five ☝️ staff members 🧑‍🏫 have been injured 🤕 according to the education ministry 📑 while in Paris suburbs 🏘️ cops charged 🏃‍♂️ at protesters 🪧 after projectiles 🪨 flew at them 🎯!! Tear gas 😢 was deployed 💨 in Strasbourg 🏰 when things looked too hostile 😠 and rubbish bins 🗑️ got torched 🔥 in Rennes 🏰 and Paris 🗼 again!! Police 📸 posted pics 🖼️ of seized items including petrol bombs 🧨 an axe 🪓 and mortar fireworks 🎆 showing significant damage 💥 to school gates 🚪 entrances 🚪 and fences 🕸️!!

Nelson Mandela high school 🏫 in Nantes 🛳️ suffered over two million euros 💶 in damage 🔥 after fire destroyed its glass entrance 🪟 and interior areas 🏠 according to the regional government 🏛️!! The blockades 🚧 and protests 🪧 started last week 📆 then exploded 🌋 to hundreds of schools 🏫 across the country 🇫🇷 with students 📚 complaining about long hours ⏰ hot classrooms 🌡️ and too many staff off sick 🤒!! This hits at a crucial time ⏳ for President Emmanuel Macron 👔 just six months before the next presidential election 🗳️ while planned budget cuts ✂️ to education funding 📉 have the young protesters 🧒 absolutely infuriated 😡!! Education Minister Édouard Geffray 🧔 told BFMTV 📺 that the movement has been hijacked 🏴‍☠️ by non students 👥 claiming teachers 👩‍🏫 said the faces in front weren't even their own kids 🧒!!

PARENTS 😟 are worried 😨 their children 👦 have been caught up in this wave 🌊 of violence 🩸 and unrest 😤 with one mom 👩 at Claude Monet school 🏫 in southern Paris 🗼 desperately looking for her son 🧒 after banning him from joining 🛑!! Darmanin 🧔‍♂️ the justice minister ⚖️ said prosecutors 🧑‍⚖️ will hold parents 👨‍👩‍👧 liable 💰 for any damage caused by their kids 🧒 forcing them to pay for repairs 🛠️!! Since the movement kicked off 🦵 about two thousand people 👥 mostly children 🧒 have been taken into custody 🔒 while many French unions 🤝 have thrown support 🫱🏼‍🫲🏾 behind the protesting students 📚!! Education union SNEP-FSU 🏛️ public services union SNUEP-FSU 🏛️ and Solidaires 🤝 all called for members to back them up 💪 saying secondary school pupils 🧒 have the freedom 🕊️ of assembly 🗣️ association 🤝 and demonstration 🪧 so let's not let them fire 🔫 on our children 👦!!

LOLA 👧 a sixteen year old protester 🪧 told AFP 📰 on Friday 📅 that as far as they're concerned they've already won 🏆 because their school is closed 🚫 this morning 🌅!! She added that police actions 👮‍♂️ have only made things worse 😤 claiming the cops 👮‍♂️ have no right 🚫 to hit 👊 them or blast tear gas 😢 on students 📚 which just makes everyone even angrier 😠!! The education ministry 📑 confirmed significant damage 💥 to facilities 🏫 after attacks on gates 🚪 entrances 🚪 and fences 🕸️ while firefighters 🚒 worked overtime 🕒 putting out burning barricades 🔥 in places like Aubervilliers 🏙️!! This whole situation 🌀 has sent shivers ❄️ down the French government's spine 🦴 especially with the presidential election 🗳️ looming and budget cuts ✂️ fueling the teenage rage 🔥 that shows no sign of stopping 🛑 anytime soon ⏰!!
